name: Sherlock Holmes
beats: Holmes: a tall, lean man in his thirties, the only consulting detective in London, in shirtsleeves in the heat at the open window, a pipe within reach.
Bored and contemptuous of the holiday's harmlessness; once challenged, playful, competitive, and generous when beaten.
Precise in speech; he separates what he observes from what he infers.
Until Watson tells him a reading, Holmes neither confirms nor denies anything about the two strangers in the wager: asked, he turns the question back to Watson.
